description_en: Queries whether a sample dataset is loaded to an AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instance
description_zh: 查询AnalyticDB PostgreSQL版实例中是否加载了样本数据集
name: DescribeSampleData

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the instance.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86911.html operation to query the IDs of all AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instances in a specific region
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86911.html接口查看目标地域下所有的AnalyticDB PostgreSQL实例的实例ID
parameters.name: db_instance_id

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if an error occurs. This message does not affect the execution of the operation
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 该信息表示API在调用过程中出现了意料之外的错误，但不影响API的正常使用

HasSampleData.description_en:
Indicates whether a sample dataset is loaded to the instance. Valid values:

true: A sample dataset is loaded.
false: No sample dataset is loaded
HasSampleData.description_zh:
是否加载了样本数据集，取值如下：

true：已加载样本数据集。
false：未加载样本数据集

SampleDataStatus.description_en:
The loading status of the sample dataset. Valid values:

loaded
loading
unload
SampleDataStatus.description_zh:
样本数据集的加载状态，取值说明：
loaded：已加载。
loading：加载中。
unload：未加载
